method: Hsu-inspired augmented evolutionary score plus reference-centered one-hot Ridge
replication_status: adaptation, not exact paper reproduction; ESM-2 35M instead of original ESM/evolutionary density models; WT masked marginal log odds instead of full sequence approximate PLL
score: sum over mutated positions of log P(mutant amino acid | reference with that position masked) minus log P(reference amino acid | same masked reference)
deployment: Hsu_ESM2_OneHot_Ridge with full-data inner A selection, regardless of outer performance
A: inner mean Spearman, then proportional-top measured mean S, then negative masked MSE
B: inner mean proportional-top measured mean S, then Spearman, then negative masked MSE
splits: reuse exact train/test/inner indices from all81_ridge_loco_baselines_20260928
labels: all81 observed C labels; missing never zero; score S=C388-(C295+C871)/2; OOF evaluation complete66
random_baseline: uniformly select K of the same 66; exact hypergeometric overlap tail, unadjusted descriptive p-values
full_sequence_onehot: sparse 493x20 reference-centered delta encoding; fixed canonical AA alphabet, no test-label-dependent feature selection
scaling: onehot unscaled; ESM scalar standardized per-C training rows then multiplied by score_weight; fitted within every inner/outer train split
resources: one GPU physical1 only for 493 masked reference forward passes; CPU2 for regression; no new dependencies
budget: 66 outer folds, 20 feature/config combinations x2 inner folds x3 C fits=7920 inner scalar Ridge fits; at most1188 outer scalar refits for A/B; full refit afterward
